info.title: FindMyPub API
info.description:
The latest documentation for the FindMyPub REST API.

Access JSON endpoints for API discovery. Authenticate using your client id and
secret, then use a bearer token to authorise against endpoints such as
screening.

post.description:
Evaluate a candidate's answers against a client's qualification rules and
return the business outcome: `pass`, or `fail` with one or more reasons.
Nothing is persisted.

default.description: API tokens are provided on request.

name.description: Human-readable name used to identify the token.

abilities.description: Sanctum abilities granted to the token, narrowed to those already granted to the app. Defaults to the app's own abilities.

expires_in.description: Number of minutes until the token expires. Defaults to 10.

client_id.description: Public client identifier issued to the API app.

client_secret.description: Client secret issued alongside the client identifier.

agreement_type.description: One or more agreement type names used to select the client's qualification rules. Accepts a single name or an array of names.

candidate.description: Candidate answers evaluated by the screening rules.

bankrupt.description: Whether the candidate has been declared bankrupt.

ccj.description: Whether the candidate has a county court judgment (CCJ).

uk_resident.description: Whether the candidate is a UK resident.

personal_licence.description: Whether the candidate holds a personal licence.

peat.description: Whether the candidate satisfies the PEAT screening criterion.

has_visited.description: Whether the candidate has visited the vacancy. Defaults to true.

rejected_by_fmp.description: Whether the candidate was previously rejected by FindMyPub.

rejected_by_client.description: Whether the candidate was previously rejected by the client.

minimum_cleared_funds.description: Candidate's minimum cleared funds in whole pounds (GBP).

planned_investment.description: Candidate's planned investment in whole pounds (GBP).

types_of_pubs_looking_for.description: Types of pubs the candidate is looking for.

items.description: A type of pub the candidate is looking for.

vacancy.description: Vacancy details used by the screening rules.

total_ingoing.description: Vacancy's total ingoing costs in whole pounds (GBP).

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
